name: Gaining-sharing update
equation: junior: u_i = x_i + KF*[(x_{R1}-x_{R2}) + s_J*(x_{R3}-x_i)]; senior: u_i = x_i + KF*[(x_{R1}-x_{R3}) + s_S*(x_{R2}-x_i)]; s_J=+1 if f(x_i)>f(x_R3) else -1; s_S=+1 if f(x_i)>f(x_R2) else -1 (i.e. +1 when the fitness-compared source -- junior R3, senior R2 -- is fitter than x_i)

name: Crossover mask
equation: v_ij = u_ij if (mask_ij) else x_ij; mask = Bernoulli(KR) or a linkage-block mask shared across the block B containing j; blocks are chunks of a random coordinate permutation (arbitrary index sets, NOT contiguous ranges)

name: ACE bandit credit + probability
equation: d_m = sum_i(f(x_i)-f(v_i)) per arm; S = sum_m d_m; tau = d/S if S>0, else max(d,0)/sum max(d,0) if S<0 and any d_m>0, else hold; pi <- P((1-c)pi + c P(tau)) with P = Euclidean projection onto {y_m>=pi_min, sum y=1}

name: L-SHADE midpoint bound repair
equation: v_ij <- (x_ij + bound_j)/2 if v_ij out of [l_j,u_j]

name: Budget-safe escape Cauchy rescue
equation: x_i <- repair(x_i + gamma*C(0,1)) for worst round(r_c*NP) UNFROZEN rows (top round(0.05*NP) elites frozen); r_c=bse_cauchy_frac=0.10 is the Cauchy fraction, NOT the r_rst restart fraction; capped by R_max, x<bse_stop_frac

name: SGSM interaction-graph EMA
equation: G <- lambda*G + eta*sum(outer(delta_accepted)) over strictly-improving accepted moves only (DE weight 0, LS weight 0.25); this is the UPDATE only -- the conf>=kappa_min consumption gate (ig_ready) is separate and not part of this EMA

name: Eigenframe compass polish
equation: x* <- compass_search(x*, V=eig(G_signed), strict budget, no RNG)

name: Substream child-seeding
equation: stream_k = threefry_child(seed, k), k in [0..12]; stream_0 = threefry(seed)
